metadata.goal: Improve Windows TUI input debugging and Enter handling.

update_md5_placeholder.name: enhanced_input_enter_detection
update_md5_placeholder.semantics: Handle Enter even when Ink does not set key.return (treat \\r/\\n as Enter).

update_md5_placeholder.name: input_handler_debug_state_log
update_md5_placeholder.semantics: When GROK_DEBUG_INPUT is enabled, also log input state changes (so we can prove whether typing mutates input).
update_md5_placeholder.find_text: // Hook up the actual input handling

update_md5_placeholder.name: readme_debug_input_file
update_md5_placeholder.semantics: Document GROK_DEBUG_INPUT_FILE and JSONL logging for typing issues.
update_md5_placeholder.find_text: This shows a debug line under the footer with `inputChar`, `key.sequence`, and modifier flags; copy it into an issue report.
update_md5_placeholder.content_md5_placeholder: This shows a debug line under the footer and also appends JSONL events to `logs/input_debug.jsonl` (override path with `GROK_DEBUG_INPUT_FILE`). Attach the JSONL file when reporting input issues.

update_md5_placeholder.name: readme_cmd_runner_note
update_md5_placeholder.semantics: Remove outdated cmd_runner --pty/ConPTY note; clarify Ink output capture limitations.
update_md5_placeholder.find_text: Note: `cmd_runner.py start --pty` uses ConPTY and is useful for some CLI apps, but Ink TUIs may exit immediately if they detect a non-interactive TTY.
update_md5_placeholder.content_md5_placeholder: Note: Ink TUIs often render using the terminal alternate screen buffer, so `stdout.log` may not contain the visible UI; prefer `GROK_DEBUG_INPUT=1` and the JSONL log for reproducible key events.
